component: Enterprise policy helper exports and test callers

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The port removes the local exported setAndLockPref, PoliciesUtils and runOnce helpers without re-exporting them. At that exact revision, registered tests still destructure those names from the local Policies module and call them. This is a checked static export/caller mismatch. Accepted source later imports runOnce from the shared helper and has no browser API test file. Those later changes are separate; no test was run and no claim about the paired Gecko helper implementation follows.
title: The initial policy-helper port leaves tests importing removed local exports
